principle: Public memory may accumulate when rights are cleared; personal traces consume a strictly limited forgetfulness budget and expire by default.

data_classes.name: ordinary anonymous use
data_classes.receipt: not applicable because nothing is collected

data_classes.name: voluntary service session
data_classes.receipt: session-level deletion receipt available without creating an account

data_classes.name: controlled test event
data_classes.receipt: event closure record; incident hold requires named authority and scope

data_classes.name: cleared public contribution
data_classes.maximum_retention: until withdrawal or stated archival term
data_classes.receipt: version, rights basis, edit history and withdrawal state

forbidden_combinations: reuse D1-D3 for advertising or resident scoring
retain raw face or voice merely for service analytics
make withdrawal contingent on account creation
treat D4 public contribution as consent to track the contributor

audit.frequency: after every test window and monthly during operation
audit.failure_action: freeze collection, preserve only minimum incident evidence, notify users, restore ordinary service and open an independent review
